text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document
outlines the inspection checklist I1, which 
must be carried out every 3 months
as indicated by (M3) at the above 
title block. The 
first draft has been 
initiated by eng. El-Sayed 
Abdel Moneam El-Geddawy and 
tested at 4/5/02 for Saker Qoraish Circuit no. 1 at 
First Urban Community 66kv Substation, Cairo zone
Safety 
Precautions
Wear your personnel safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, and safety harness,
Work order must be issued and the 
 qualified
 maintenance staff must carry the suitable
 safety category.
Switch on the earthing switch and check mechanical interlocking with the 
 disconnector
Switch off DC source
Environmental Precautions
Tools and Equipments
Suitable tool set, safety helmet,
Safety shoes, breathing mask, and safety harness
Pieces of 
 clothes and rags
Grease and 
 cleaning liquid (like gasoline)
Work to be carried out
Clean contact 
 pieces and contact fingers of disconnectors from dust and dirt
Remove old grease 
 and put new (choose suitable grease such as tremalene 
 grease 64444 or non - acid Vaseline as manufacturer recommends)
Clean contacts 
 of earthing switch and remove old grease and put new
Check disconnector 
 joints
Check the earthing switch 
 joints
Check flexible 
 connection of earthing switches
Check all 
 screwed joints for tight fit
Clean insulators 
 from dirt and dust
Clean auxiliary 
 instruments (contactors, relays, limit switch) with video cleaner
